hierarchy_isolation.scope: Offline hierarchy isolation with captured conditional RGB moments, 12-bin flux SAH + Kr and the original model 6.
hierarchy_isolation.residual_scope: Global - upper-only - inner-only + prefix is a nonadditive remainder. Global crosses the brick boundary and is not the composition of the two controlled substitutions.

validation.root_oracle_cross_check: Both red-pillar windows and all four trees, A_j reconstructed from marginal leaf PMF times existing root probability.

interpretation: Neither controlled substitution reproduces the red-pillar penalty. The full repartition across brick boundaries changes the conditional proposals below the root. The nonadditive remainder does not identify a pure interaction between two independently combined edits.
Optimizing only the root of the global candidate removes about 14% of its excess conditional variance over World Prefix. Around 2.39–2.40 times the prefix variance remains.

Upper-only preserves the red pillar, improves ls5 and all moving-4 sampled faces, and improves the older ls1 points. It loses the global candidate improvement on the new central ceiling, where variance rises above World Prefix.
This is a finite fixed-receiver diagnostic with intact bricks as an experimental control. It does not establish a runtime fix or limit future cross-brick clustering.

composition_cross_check.scope: Experiment author independently assembled Nodes from the three source NPZ references; same SAH constructors reused. Compared exact tree arrays and independently evaluated the 28 variance ratios against the review scalar PMF result.

clustering_rule_screen.scope: Offline conditional RGB variance. Original Half-space A + Near/Far (model 6), same leaves and binary-to-four collapse.
clustering_rule_screen.rule_details: 12 buckets and X/Y/Z then lowest bucket tie-break for diagonal costs. Center rules use longest doubled integer center span, X/Y/Z ties, low-inclusive midpoint, floor count median or first minimum flux imbalance, with canonical world keys for ties.
clustering_rule_screen.gate: Every named gate point-window must be at most Prefix. Rank by maximum gate variance ratio, then maximum overall variance ratio, then method name. A missing positive-M2 leaf ranks as infinite.
clustering_rule_screen.work_proxies: Expected reached internal nodes and expected nonempty child records, including reached null stops.

findings.best: upper/flux-diagonal missed only the two red-pillar windows. Its red-pillar maximum of 1.05654x is also the maximum over all 28 windows.
findings.red_pillar: On window 1 the largest added penalty is [146,153,88,682]. Its PMF falls from 0.00857835 to 0.00716028. The root near contribution remains 0.5 and the root far contribution falls from 0.4016 to 0.1956. The new path also has a 0.0107 near + 0.0635 far step. The final unchanged split is 0.2618 near + 0.2627 far.
findings.ceiling: The same upper rule raises [171,151,95,6598] from 0.00056656 to 0.00126492. A near-zero-assignment ancestor remains (0.0000 near + 0.1504 far on the new path); fewer preceding discounts and larger downstream reach produce a net gain. The final three within-brick splits are unchanged.
findings.moving: For side-a, [110,76,364,10242] rises from 0.23278 to 0.34621. The first two prefix and candidate near halves remain 0.5, the first two far halves are smaller in the candidate, and the path drops four ancestor factors. Side-b and top also have higher probability on their dominant measured light under both diagnosed rules.
findings.runner_up: upper/count-diagonal shifts red-pillar probability toward [146,153,88,682] and away from [154,146,78,10254]. The latter loses the near half entirely at one upper split. The measured added red-pillar penalties exceed the reductions. Its worst retained old ls1-wall window is 2.44312x.
findings.scope: Window-conditional variance and traversed-record proxies only. No new captures, shader or runtime comparisons.

flat_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic all-leaf Half-space A + Near/Far normalization, with independent scalar star-tree evaluation. O(N) per receiving point, not a proposed runtime sampler or best possible distribution.
flat_diagnostic.interpretation: Flattening current leaf geometric A+NearFar weights still increases red-pillar variance by about 25%, while helping the ceiling and moving points. The existing hierarchy happens to reallocate probability usefully for some red-pillar lights. This is not a proof that all clustering fails or that flat weights are the optimal distribution.
